_note: Hand-curated original paths for native pieces the census cannot name. Folder evidence: the iOS 2.132 (Dec 2013) linker debug map carries the build agent's real source paths, and Roblox's Ogre-derived classes are in Client/Rendering/RbxOgre/ as Rbx<Class>.cpp there (RbxEntity, RbxSceneManager, RbxSceneNode, RbxSky, RbxSubEntity, RbxSubMesh, Quadric, RbxGeometryGenerator). OpenRBX, a Dec 2007 decompilation, put the same classes in AppDraw, which is the decompiler's arrangement, so the real build paths win. The 2008 exe's own file string is '.\\RbxSceneManager.cpp' (0084e9e8, no folder). Every entry is an inferred path (kept under inferred/), never Authentic.
